hypothesis.baseline: Archived h0885, 2.4 s approach, w_vel 0, full 35-node MPC, dt 0.02 s, estimated-state seed 17
hypothesis.measured_failure: Startup acceleration 226.123 rad/s^2; wrist speed 1.18279 m/s. Initial command jumps by 0.03220 rad and 1.60999 rad/s with 59.0919 N m feedforward. Initial physical contact count is zero. Fixed-position startup still reaches 175.625 rad/s^2 and 0.36458 m/s wrist speed.
hypothesis.hypothesis: An additional velocity cost reduces the commanded component of startup motion; unsupported initial-pose contact acquisition leaves an acceleration transient even when approach motion is reduced.
hypothesis.intervention: Re-solve the original 200-node plan at w_vel=1.0 using the original solution as the warm start. Retain 120 approach nodes, 80 brace nodes, all other costs, model, target and initial state. Online MPC uses the same extra velocity cost.
hypothesis.weight_basis: Existing approach state-velocity weight is 0.1. Added weight 1.0 is a tenfold relative penalty chosen to test the measured motion mechanism; it is not a hardware-derived velocity limit.
hypothesis.comparison: Re-run original plan and re-solved plan for 6 s with identical estimated-state path, gains, initialization and one MPC iteration; compare first 0.5 s and final 1 s.
hypothesis.falsification: Reject a startup acceleration benefit unless peak decreases at least 10 percent; assess joint/wrist speed separately. Reject retained-brace benefit if final-second table support falls below 5 N, reach RMS increases more than 5 mm, or sole displacement increases more than 5 mm. Thresholds are simulation comparison criteria, not hardware safety limits.
hypothesis.recovery: Original schedule contains no return phase; recovery unavailable.

decision.recovery: Unavailable: both plans have n_return=0; no recovery claim.
decision.hardware: No hardware data or commands. Synthetic base-state error, ideal joint/velocity observations and synchronous free-running simulation. Hardware actuator bandwidth and supported handover require measurement.
decision.mechanism: Initial unsupported state and servo/contact settling contribute: fixed-position startup alone reaches 175.625 rad/s^2. The velocity penalty reduces approach speed and saturation, but leaves 223.628 rad/s^2 acceleration at first foot loading. A duration-only cause is insufficient; no duration sweep was run.
decision.promotion: Keep opt-in. Retains brace and reach, but acceleration and sole-displacement criteria fail; predicted contact forces remain infeasible.

metrics.startup: First 0.5 s; peak joint acceleration is adjacent velocity finite difference over 2 ms.
metrics.wrist: World translational speed of left wrist-yaw body origin, J(q) v. Contact onset: first physical witness normal >1 N.
metrics.tracking: RMS over 27 actuated joints and first 0.5 s; logged command minus sampled joint state.
metrics.slip: World-horizontal speed of foot material point at a floor contact witness with normal >5 N.
metrics.support: Sum of robot-table contact normal force, measured separately from prescribed predictor forces.
metrics.forces: Predicted world-aligned force at contact origin; cone rows 0..4 N, moment rows N m. MuJoCo force in contact frame; native cone includes torsion and rolling.
metrics.joint_margin: Minimum distance of actual joint position to either MJCF bound, radians; negative is a violation.
metrics.runtime: One solver thread, one BoxFDDP iteration, 35 nodes at 0.02 s; latency compensation disabled. Percentiles cover full 6 s simulation.
